name: Pulse Drums Techno
author: Freek van Gool
description: Techno kits for Pulse Drums in eight styles: techno, minimal, peak time, hard techno, dub techno, acid, electro and breaks. The kits use what Pulse adds: the kick layers, FM percussion, polymetric channel lengths, rumble and grit. Loading a tune switches the device's own sequencer off, so you can audition the kit with your own sequencer; switch it back on to hear the groove stored in the tune. Drum and bass folders (around 172 to 176 BPM) with a two-bar groove in pattern A, a variation in B, a breakdown in C and a fill in D: Tech Step, Dancefloor DnB, Neurofunk, Jungle, Halftime DnB and Jump Up, with rumble and grit set per kit.
